Title: Heroes of the Storm Live Patch Notes - June 2, 2025
Subtitle: [Heroes of the Storm Live Patch Notes - June 2, 2025] New patch arrived to celebrate 10 Year Anniversary of Heroes of the Storm! Read on for more information. View Full Article
Highlights: [Heroes of the Storm Live Patch Notes - June 2, 2025] New patch arrived to celebrate 10 Year Anniversary of Heroes of the Storm! Read on for more information. View Full Article
CleanedNotes:
=== General ===
[Updates]
  Shop:
  • Players who are unable to purchase Gems in-game can now purchase Gems in the Battle.net Shop.

=== Heroes: Anduin ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing damage against non-Heroes to give Push Forward's stacks.
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing Lightbomb's damage to not give Push Forward's stacks.

=== Heroes: Brightwing ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Base
    • Arcane Flare [Q]
      • Minimum cast range removed.
      • No longer bypasses flight time when cast inside Brightwing's space.

=== Heroes: ETC ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Level 20
    • Power of the Horde
      • Fixed missing cast animations.
      • Fixed missing Power of the Horde cast visual.
    • Ride the Lightning
      • E.T.C. will now face the direction that Ride the Lightning is cast in.
      • Fixed missing cast animations.

=== Heroes: Gazlowe ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Level 10
    • Grav-O-Bomb 3000
      • Minimum cast range removed.
      • No longer bypasses flight time when cast inside Gazlowe's space.

=== Heroes: Hanzo ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Base
    • Sonic Arrow [E]
      • Minimum cast range removed.
      • No longer bypasses flight time when cast inside Hanzo's space.

=== Heroes: Imperius ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing Imperius's Molten Armor to hit multiple targets when a Hero is in range, but they are not a valid target.
  • [Undocumented] The healing from Imperius's Valorous Brand is no longer shown as coming from Basic Attacks in the Death Recap.

=== Heroes: Murky ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Base
    • Pufferfish [W]
      • Minimum cast range removed.
      • No longer bypasses flight time when cast inside Murky's space.

=== Heroes: Orphea ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Base
    • Shadow Waltz [Q]
      • ~~Fixed an issue that caused Orphea to not dash when moving after hitting an enemy Hero with Shadow Waltz.~~

=== Heroes: Tychus ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Base
    • Frag Grenade [W]
      • Minimum cast range removed.
      • No longer bypasses flight time when cast inside Tychus's space.
